hints.2: Look at their pawn on b2, their king on h2 and their rook on d1: one move can hit all of them after your first move. Use your rook on d8 -- the piece you give up, then your bishop. Which square hits both?
hints.3: Rxd6, an exchange sacrifice, and after Rxd6, Be5+, and the bishop on e5 forks the king on h2, the rook on d6 and the pawn on b2; you win a bishop.
hints.4: The line is Rxd6 Rxd6 Be5+ Kh1 Bxd6. Rxd6, an exchange sacrifice, and after Rxd6, Be5+, and the bishop on e5 forks the king on h2, the rook on d6 and the pawn on b2; you win a bishop.
